description: Mutated-input attack against an externally-launched HTTP/1.1 target. A seed request (GET /plaintext) is mutated by radamsa (https://gitlab.com/akihe/radamsa) into a stream of malformed HTTP/1.1 requests, each fired over a fresh TCP connection. Whatever the mutated bytes are, the target MUST NOT crash, OOM, or hang. PRIMARY CHECK: after attack window + cooldown, target serves clean GET /health with 200 OK. SECONDARY CHECK: process RSS delta within tolerance (no leaked Arenas).

attack_profile.radamsa_seed: REQUIRED — set via --radamsa-seed; without this the campaign is not reproducible

comparison_axis_note: Cross-stack radamsa results require IDENTICAL --radamsa-seed for fair comparison. Different seeds produce different inputs; comparing different seeds is meaningless. Label the seed in any cross-stack report row.
publication_mode_reason: Radamsa-mutated payloads written to disk on crash (crash-*.radamsa) contain attacker-supplied bytes; basename blocklist in publish-report.sh blocks them outside internal-only mode.
